name: Run controls (PRD_RUN_CONTROLS): the run page can run the controller's own recovery and decision commands (restart or pause the supervisor, retry a check, reconcile, resume or accept the design challenge, release a hold, answer, approve, repair a lane, abandon, clean) as the operator, behind pairing, origin and host checks, confirmations and a stale-state guard, and shows each control's progress and result; off by default, no engine change
